__typename.description: GraphQL type name of this object.

itemQuantity.description: The configured ratio: `itemQuantity` principal units to `ancillaryQuantity` ancillary units, as on `AncillaryItemNode`

wastageRate.description: The principal's wastage rate (%) deducted before the ratio applies; 0 when none

ownWastageRate.description: The ancillary's own wastage rate (%) as a supply, added on top of the ratio; 0 when none

principalUsableConsumption.description: The principal's monthly demand net of the deducted wastage

monthlyConsumption.description: This principal's share of the line's monthly demand
